native_mechanisms: Each mark poured into the never-pure cup, the changed colour seeding the next pour, so the whole pile passes as one unbroken sequential chain.
The final colour carried through seven organs in turn, each bending and discarding half of what it received (halving shift ladder) before passing on.
Flip one mark anywhere and re-pour the whole pile; any resemblance between new and old token condemns the method (avalanche self-test).
core_technique: Multi-lane (8-way scalar / 16-way AVX2) rotate-add byte accumulation with length tempering, folded into one word and finished by a 6-step halving xor-shift + rotate ladder plus one shift-add — i.e. an xxHash-style multi-accumulator hash with a standard strong finalizer; the native's single unbroken chain survives only on the <32-byte path, and the seven-organ halving ladder survives fully but only as the final mix.
